question: When stepping into a brand-new region, what is your first instinct?

options.text: Challenge every trainer, conquer Gyms, and prove I'm the strongest!
Explore every nook and cranny without anyone telling me where to go.
Unravel ancient local folklore, mythical legends, and historical secrets.
Take it easy, enjoy the atmosphere, and bond closely with my partner Pokémon.

question: What kind of visual art style appeals most to your nostalgic soul?

options.text: Peak classic 2D pixel art with buttery-smooth animated battle sprites.
Chunky, retro Game Boy nostalgia — 8-bit or 16-bit chiptunes and pure charm.
Vibrant 3D camera sweeps, dynamic lighting, and cinematic action battles.
Expansive open-horizon wilderness with seamless day/night weather vistas.

question: How do you prefer your battle difficulty and tactical depth?

options.text: Hardcore! I want ruthless Champion teams with competitive items and fierce AI.
Innovative and kinetic — manual rolling, throwing balls, and real-time danger!
Grand spectacle! Giant stadium crowds cheering, colossal transformations, and hype music.
Relaxed and comforting, perfect for unwinding on the couch after a long day.

question: What kind of story narrative draws you in?

options.text: A philosophical conflict questioning human nature and the morality of battles.
A cosmic battle against apocalyptic forces threatening the dimensional fabric.
A personal coming-of-age journey full of friendship, school life, and heartfelt discoveries.
The classic, straightforward quest to take down a greedy mafia crime syndicate.

question: Pick your favorite signature game mechanic:

options.text: Mega Evolution — unleashing ultimate dormant battle transformations!
Your favorite Pokémon walking faithfully right behind you in the overworld.
The Battle Frontier — endless modular endgame tournament facilities.
Terastallization — sparkling crystal hats changing elemental typings on the fly.

question: What is your philosophy toward Legendary Pokémon?

options.text: Deities of creation, space, time, and antimatter commanding cosmic respect.
Guardians of nature, harmony, seas, and skies resting in tranquil sanctuaries.
Loyal companions who travel beside you as your trusted ride mount throughout your tale.
Ancient bioweapons, fusion specimens, and otherworldly extraterrestrial beasts.

question: Which setting feels most like home to you?

options.text: Traditional wooden shrines, cherry blossoms, and sacred bell towers.
A bustling metropolis with suspension bridges, subways, and neon avenues.
Sun-soaked tropical islands, sandy beaches, and welcoming sea breezes.
Vast untamed snowfields, rugged mountain trails, and ancient pine forests.

question: Finally: what makes a Pokémon journey truly unforgettable?

options.text: The sheer wealth of content, side quests, and post-game achievements.
Total freedom to forge my own path without invisible walls holding me back.
The unforgettable feeling of overcoming a legendary Champion in the final bout.
The pure, unadulterated nostalgia of where my lifelong passion first began.
